parts.text: In this experiment, you will take measurements of a sample of modelling clay. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) You are provided with a piece of modelling clay. The shape of the piece of modelling clay is approximately a cube.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the volume V A of the modelling clay, using the equation V A = hwd . V A = ............................................... cm 3

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Measure the mass m of the modelling clay, using the balance provided. m = ....................................................g

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate the density ρ of the modelling clay, using the equation ρ = m V A . ρ = ...................................................... [4]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Mould the piece of modelling clay into an approximate sphere. Use the rule and the blocks of wood to measure the diameter d of the sphere of modelling clay. d = ................................................. [1]

ms.label: 1(b)(i)
ms.text: sensible d value – not smaller than all of h, w, d

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw a diagram to show how you used the blocks of wood and the rule to measure the diameter of the sphere of modelling clay. [1]

ms.label: 1(b)(ii)
ms.text: the sphere, and rule spanning gap and touching blocks

parts.label: i
parts.text: (c) (i) Pour approximately 100 cm 3 of water into the measuring cylinder. Record the volume of water V 1 in the measuring cylinder. V 1 = ......................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Mould the modelling clay into a shape that will fit into the measuring cylinder. Tie the thread round the modelling clay and lower it into the measuring cylinder until it is completely covered with water. Record the new volume V 2. V 2 = ......................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate the volume V B of the modelling clay using the equation V B = ( V 2 − V 1 ). V B = ...................................................... [2]
